description: This file defines the FloorDivBinary class, which implements floor division for the Twig templating engine. It extends AbstractBinary and overrides methods to compile the operation into PHP code, performing a floor division operation.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\Binary\FloorDivBinary
classes.description: A class implementing floor division operator for Twig, converting it into appropriate PHP code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to perform floor division, wrapping parent compile output within floor function and cast to int.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string representing the division operator, which is '/' in this class.
